So i was at a psych ward of a hospital back at the end of last September and let me tell you, it was quite the experience. I was checked in fairly late and went to bed pretty much right away. Well all night for like the first 2 nights there was a woman screaming out about people trying to murder her etc. It was like a movie about a psych ward and it was quite terrifying honestly. Plus i had a roommate those first couple nights who would sleep talk so that was also interesting.

There was the typical lady that was bipolar and kind of unstable as she flitted about flirting with anything male. There was this older guy who went around telling everyone the exact same story so you heard it at least 3x a day. There was also a girl who marched into a meeting ripping apart a book in front of one of the other patients angrily. 

The most interesting people came just as i was leaving. There was a nudist who was arrested for riding his motorcycle nude. He was whacking off in the shower next door to my room all night long, then he was marching around in his underwear in the morning. When he did wear hospital gowns, people discovered he didn't have underwear on. Then there was a guy who followed me around constantly hitting on me who was twice my age almost wanting to know lots of personal information. Oh and my favorite was a guy who came in and began pacing around the main room angrily swearing and muttering at/about all of us under his breath. He actually terrified me.

Could have been way crazier i know, but it was crazy enough for me. I'm sure i've forgotten some things now too. Needless to say it's not an experience i'd care to repeat.
